name: FastAPI
summary: A Python framework for building APIs, the server part that other apps and pages call.

free_plan_covers.note: Free and open source under the MIT license. You pay only for hosting.

first_paid_usd_month.note: No paid plan. The framework itself is free.

portability.note: Runs in Docker, on a server you set up or on many cloud hosts.

language.note: Written in Python using type hints.

has_server_code.note: Your API endpoints run only on the server, so secrets stay private.

uses_react.note: FastAPI builds APIs that return data. Screens need a separate frontend, which may or may not use React.

setup.step: Install it with pip install "fastapi[standard]", start it with fastapi dev, and push the project to a GitHub repository.

builder_notes: Read settings and secrets with a pydantic-settings BaseSettings class. It reads environment variables and can load a .env file.
Keep the .env file out of Git.
